title: next_version('prerelease', token) returns an older version when the token differs and sorts lower
property: next_version(...) is strictly greater than the original version (natural order preserved)
evidence: Docstring: 'Determines next version, preserving natural order.' The 'next' version must not sort before the current one; the branch at version.py:561-565 replaces the prerelease by '<token>.1' without checking order.
